23235d9755128a02.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

Our Tee team is looking to bring on a Business Development Representative to help bring an innovative, AI-powered product to market. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team at the forefront of agentic AI and help drive adoption of emerging technology.

Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC. For candidates based in NYC, this role follows a 2-day-per-week hybrid schedule. Candidates outside of NYC metropolitan area may work fully remotely based EST hours.

What You’ll Do

• Lead Generation & Pipeline Development

• Develop and implement comprehensive inbound and outbound strategies to generate a steady pipeline of qualified prospects.

• Drive lead generation efforts to support overall sales objectives.

• Outbound Outreach & Engagement

• Initiate and lead targeted outreach to prospective clients through personalized email campaigns, strategic phone calls, and effective social selling techniques.

• Conduct in-depth research to identify and analyze the unique needs and challenges of prospective customers, ensuring a tailored approach to engagement.

• Sales Facilitation & Deal Management: Facilitate and coordinate discovery meetings between sales representatives and prospects to foster relationships and uncover further opportunities.

• Performance & Results: Consistently surpass sales targets and quotas through proactive strategies and a focus on results-driven performance.

• Performs other related duties as assigned. 

About You 

• College graduate with a strong desire to learn and grow in a sales environment.

• Minimum 2 yrs and expert proficiency in outbound email tools & CRM such as Outreach, Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.

• Genuine interest in the mental health and well-being industry.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong commitment to personal and professional development.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain stakeholder support.

• Collaborative team player who thrives in a mission-driven environment.

• Goal-oriented and driven to exceed expectations and contribute to team success

• Creative thinker with the ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Benefits 

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $67,000 - $95,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/talkspace-business-development-representative-ai

23e15c7094604d06.description: ABOUT QUALIFYCODE AI has made it trivial to fabricate resumes, take-home assignments, and remote interviews. QualifyCode is the integrity layer for technical hiring—helping engineering teams verify candidate work objectively while keeping every hiring decision explainable, auditable, and fair. We are a small, product-focused team in Mumbai running a live production platform used in real hiring workflows. Our product spans a proctored web coding IDE, a recruiter decision console, isolated code-execution pipelines, and automated integrity and code-quality analysis services. Everything is built and owned in-house, end to end. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to work across the full stack rather than a single siloed layer. Our system combines event-driven workflows, service-to-service APIs, and real-time client communication—so your work will span React interfaces, TypeScript and Python backend services, PostgreSQL data models, and asynchronous job queues. At this stage of our growth, the core engineering focus is scale, reliability, and hardening—driving down end-to-end latency, optimizing database queries, refining access controls, and strengthening distributed concurrency. This role fits someone who reads how a production system actually behaves before changing it, and who ships verified fixes over quick guesses. WHAT YOU’LL OWN • Candidate Coding Experience: Build and harden our browser-based IDE—editing workflows, resilient autosave, live execution feedback over WebSockets, pre-assessment environment checks, and reliable media uploads. • Recruiter Decision Console: Develop the dashboard hiring managers rely on under time pressure—candidate reports, code-quality and integrity breakdowns, session timelines, review queues, and synchronized media playback. • Core Backend & Orchestration: Design and scale APIs and state machines handling assessment lifecycles, candidate sessions, RBAC, usage accounting, and asynchronous workflows with clean contracts and idempotent failure handling. • Analysis & Scoring Pipelines: Extend our code-quality and integrity pipelines across deterministic scoring rules, telemetry processing, computer-vision signals, and bounded LLM integrations—keeping results accurate and explainable. • Reliability & Observability: Improve resilience across execution sandboxes, PostgreSQL databases, Redis queues, and object storage. Debug issues with distributed traces and metrics, and back every fix with regression tests. OUR STACK You don't need prior fluency in every tool, but you should be strong in TypeScript and comfortable moving across frontend state, backend APIs, SQL query plans, and Python services: • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Monaco Editor, Socket.IO, browser media/WASM APIs • Backend: Node.js (NestJS, Prisma, Express), Python (FastAPI) • Data & Async: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible object storage, BullMQ, Celery, Server-Sent Events • Infra & Observability: Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, k6 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years of production experience shipping full-stack web applications (or equivalent demonstrated depth). • Strong TypeScript & React fundamentals—able to reason across UI state, API lifecycles, and relational schemas in the same afternoon. • Solid backend engineering: Practical grasp of HTTP semantics, auth/RBAC, idempotency, transactions, and fault-tolerant queue retries. • PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: Comfortable with joins, indexing, migrations, and reading EXPLAIN plans. • High engineering rigor: You verify changes with tests, traces, or benchmarks before calling them done. • Immediate availability to join our Mumbai office (Hybrid). Bonus points for: A live project or readable GitHub repo with real users; experience debugging distributed race conditions or retry storms; production LLM or media/computer-vision integrations; Python async services (FastAPI/Celery); or work in audited domains like HR tech or fintech. HOW WE ENGINEER • Contract-first APIs: Shared schemas, pagination standards, and permission models are strictly typed across services. • Verification by default: Bug fixes ship with regression tests; auth changes include negative (403) tests; performance work includes measurements. • Zero-downtime evolution: Database and API changes roll out via staged, backward-compatible migrations. • Safe rollouts & CI guardrails: Feature flags, shadow-mode validation for automated scoring, and automated CI checks for timeouts and bounded queries. HOW TO APPLY Please apply at https://qualifycode.com/careers (and include the following in your application or Wellfound note): 1. A working link to something you built (a live product, open-source contribution, or GitHub repo we can read). 2. One line on which part of our stack or problem space you’d most want to own.

234b89967814e741.description:
Headquarters: Remote - India 

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
A Quick Note on the Role's Focus

While the title is Senior ML Engineer, this opportunity is specifically focused on ML Platform Engineering rather than ML model development or data science.

We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. The emphasis is on ML infrastructure, MLOps, model serving, platform reliability, and production engineering, rather than primarily developing, training, or fine-tuning ML models.

Location Note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

The Machine Learning Platform team builds the software foundations that enable data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and operate models safely and efficiently in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform.

At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll lead the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of complex platform capabilities that support the machine-learning lifecycle.

• You’ll design scalable systems for model deployment and serving, feature computation, data validation, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production support.

• You’ll build reusable platform components, standards, and automation while improving reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness across ML systems.

• You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions.

• You’ll own significant technical initiatives end to end and lead complex production investigations—clarifying requirements, leading design, delivering safely, measuring results, and implementing durable fixes.

• You’ll raise engineering quality through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentor engineers through pairing and technical guidance, and contribute to platform technical strategy.

• You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You do not need detailed implementation direction to be effective. Given an ambiguous problem and sufficient context, you can define the technical approach, explain trade-offs, align stakeholders, lead delivery, and own the outcome after launch.

You’re comfortable navigating complexity and don’t wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, mentor others, and connect engineering work to member, business, and operational outcomes.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

• You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals.

• You’ve demonstrated experience designing and operating reliable, scalable cloud-native services or data-intensive systems, with experience in ML platforms, model serving, feature engineering, data platforms, MLOps, or related systems.

• You bring practical experience with SQL, databases, caching, and tracing data or requests across multiple systems, plus familiarity with the ML lifecycle from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance.

• You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and production observability, and you can evaluate technical alternatives and clearly communicate recommendations, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies.

• You’ve demonstrated the ability to mentor engineers, improve engineering practices, lead through technical influence, and connect engineering work to member, business, product, and operational outcomes.

Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS, Databricks, MLflow, SageMaker, Spark/PySpark, Kafka, or streaming systems.

• Experience building feature platforms, model-serving systems, workflow-orchestration platforms, or internal developer platforms.

• Familiarity with monitoring model quality, data quality, feature coverage, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency, and experience working with sensitive data in a regulated or financial-services environment.

• Experience with Java or another backend language in addition to Python, and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve personal productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

India Benefits:

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

Provident Fund

Life & Accident Insurance

Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-ml-engineer-r14284
